request: A two-piece pillow block for a 608 bearing (8 x 22 x 7 mm) that is clamped, not glued. The block is split along the bearing axis into a base and a cap. Two M3 bolts with captive hex nuts pull the halves together, and the bearing pocket is about 0.1 mm under 22 mm across when the halves are closed, so the clamp holds the bearing. The base has two M4 mounting holes 40 mm apart. It is printed on an FDM printer without supports. Requirements: The block shall be two separate printed bodies, a base and a cap, split along a plane that contains the bearing axis, and closed they shall meet on that plane. With the halves closed, the bearing pocket shall be 21.9 mm across (21.85 to 21.95 mm), round, and centred on the bearing axis, so that the 22 mm bearing is squeezed by about 0.1 mm. The pocket shall hold the 7 mm wide bearing axially between two lips on the outer ring, and nothing printed shall touch the bearing's inner ring or bore. The closed halves shall touch on the split plane (gap at most 0.05 mm) over a real area (at least 100 mm2), so the bolts clamp the halves onto the bearing and not onto each other's gap. Two M3 bolts, one on each side of the bearing, shall pass through clearance holes in the cap, with their heads counterbored, into the base. Each bolt shall thread into an M3 hex nut held captive in a hex pocket in the base, open to the split face, so the nut cannot fall out or turn once the cap is on. The base shall have two M4 mounting holes 40.0 mm apart with room for the heads and a hex key. With the cap off, the bearing shall drop into the base half and the nuts into their pockets; with the cap on, every bolt and mounting screw shall be reachable with a hex key. The load shall reach the mounting holes through solid material: at least 2.5 mm of wall between the bearing pocket and any outer surface, at least 2.0 mm round every hole, counterbore and nut pocket, at least 100 mm2 of base cross-section on every plane between the block and each M4 hole, and no more than 10 MPa bending stress in the base for a 100 N pull on the bearing; the base shall be one connected body. The base and the cap shall each be one manifold body that prints on an FDM printer without supports in its stated print orientation. The closed block shall be no larger than 60 x 60 x 32 mm and shall stand flat on its mounting face without tipping. The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a cap STL (closed assembly pose, mm), the OpenSCAD source, the declared hardware layout and the agent's own measurement report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.
